contentEn:
Renovating a closet in Metro Vancouver in 2026 costs between $800 and $15,000 or more, depending on whether you need a simple reach-in refresh or a full custom walk-in buildout. This guide covers real prices for every closet type, common upgrade costs, and what to budget for your Reno Stars project.

What Does a Closet Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

The total cost of your closet renovation depends on three things: the closet type you are starting with, the materials you choose, and how much custom work is involved. Here is the 2026 Metro Vancouver price landscape.

Closet Type2026 Vancouver Cost RangeTypical Timeline
Reach-in closet refresh (stock systems)$800 – $3,0001–3 days
Reach-in custom built-in$3,000 – $8,0003–7 days
Walk-in closet (custom)$5,000 – $15,000+1–3 weeks
Luxury walk-in with island$12,000 – $30,000+2–4 weeks

Reach-In Closet: $800 – $3,000

A reach-in closet renovation typically involves replacing the existing rod and shelf system with a better-designed storage solution. In a standard 6-foot-wide by 24-inch-deep closet, homeowners in Richmond, Vancouver and Burnaby commonly spend $1,500 to $3,000 for a custom-fitted system using MDF or plywood with soft-close hardware.

At the lower end, installing adjustable closet systems from IKEA Pax or similar fitted to your closet dimensions runs $800 to $2,000 for materials and basic labour. This works well for landlords or quick upgrades before listing a property for sale.

Custom Walk-In Closet: $5,000 – $15,000+

A custom walk-in closet in a Metro Vancouver home — such as a primary bedroom walk-in in a Richmond townhouse or a Delta house — costs $5,000 to $15,000 or more depending on the size and finishes. A typical 8×10 foot walk-in with double hanging, shelving, drawers and LED lighting runs $8,000 to $12,000 with professional installation.

The key cost drivers for a walk-in are:

  • Drawer units with soft-close guides: $400–$900 each
  • LED motion-sensor lighting: $200–$600
  • Mirror panels or mirrored doors: $500–$1,500
  • Floating shelves in solid wood: $300–$800 per shelf run
  • Closet island or peninsula: $1,500–$4,000

What Materials Are Best for a Vancouver Closet Renovation?

Metro Vancouver's climate — which sees humidity fluctuations between dry summers and damp winters — affects which materials perform best in a closet. Particle board or MDF with edge banding is the most budget-friendly option and works well in a climate-controlled interior. Solid wood or plywood veneer is more durable long-term and resists the minor swelling that can affect unsealed particle board near exterior walls.

Reno Stars typically recommends plywood-core construction with a laminate or wood-veneer finish for most homeowners who want a balance of durability and cost. Solid wood is reserved for luxury closets where the budget allows.

How Long Does a Closet Renovation Take?

Most closet renovations in Metro Vancouver are completed in less than two weeks from demolition to final inspection. A simple reach-in refresh takes one to three days. A custom walk-in with electrical work (adding outlets or LED lighting circuits) typically takes one to two weeks, including the time needed for any permits if electrical work is involved.

Does a Closet Renovation Need a Permit in BC?

In British Columbia, a closet renovation by itself does not usually require a building permit. However, if your project involves moving walls, adding electrical circuits, or modifying the structural framing of your home, a permit from your municipality will be required. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our standard project process.

If you are converting a bedroom to a closet or adding a closet in a strata property, check with your strata council first — some renovations require strata approval before work begins.

Real Reno Stars Closet and Built-In Projects

Reno Stars has completed custom built-in storage projects across Metro Vancouver. Here are three recent examples:

  • Delta whole house renovation with custom storage — included master bedroom closet built-ins
  • Richmond whole house renovation — featured custom pantry and closet organization
  • North Vancouver bathroom renovation — included ensuite vanity and storage upgrades

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Closet Renovation Costs: Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost of a closet renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

The average closet renovation in Metro Vancouver costs between $3,000 and $8,000 for a custom reach-in or small walk-in. High-end walk-in closets with islands, solid wood finishes and lighting can reach $15,000 to $30,000.

Is a closet renovation worth it before selling a home?

Yes. A professional closet renovation typically recoups 70–85% of its cost in resale value, according to Renovation Recovery reports for the BC Lower Mainland market. A well-organized reach-in closet is one of the most positively scored features by Metro Vancouver home buyers.

How long does a walk-in closet renovation take?

A custom walk-in closet renovation takes one to three weeks in Metro Vancouver, depending on the complexity of the build, whether electrical work is included, and the availability of materials. Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule at the estimate stage.

What is the best material for a closet in Vancouver's climate?

Plywood-core cabinetry with laminate or wood veneer is the best all-around choice for Vancouver's climate. Avoid unsealed particle board in closets adjacent to exterior walls or bathrooms. Solid wood is the premium choice and is well-suited to climate-controlled primary bedroom closets.

Does a closet renovation require a building permit in BC?

A standalone closet renovation — replacing shelving, rods and doors — does not usually require a permit. If the project involves structural changes, wall moves or new electrical circuits, a permit from your municipality is required. Reno Stars manages all permit applications.

contentZh:
2026年，大溫哥華及周邊城市的衣櫃或儲物間裝修費用從800加元到15,000加元以上不等，具體取決於工程規模、材料選擇，以及是否需要定制櫃體。本文詳解各類型衣櫃的真實報價、常见增項費用，以及聚星裝修（reno-stars.com）的實際案例。

2026年溫哥華衣櫃裝修費用明細

衣櫃裝修總價主要取決於三個因素：現有衣櫃類型、所選材料及定制程度。以下是2026年大溫哥華市場的價格區間。

衣櫃類型2026年溫哥華價格區間典型工期
普通衣櫃改造（成品系統）$800 – $3,0001–3天
定制嵌入式普通衣櫃$3,000 – $8,0003–7天
步入式衣櫃（定制）$5,000 – $15,000+1–3週
豪華步入式衣櫃（含中島）$12,000 – $30,000+2–4週

普通衣櫃改造：$800 – $3,000

普通衣櫃改造通常指更換原有的掛杆和層板系統，升級為設計更合理的儲物方案。在列治文、溫哥華及本拿比常見的6尺寬、24寸深標準衣櫃中，定制適配系統（使用MDF或膠合板，配備軟關緩衝五金）的費用一般在$1,500至$3,000之間。

若選擇IKEA Pax等成品系統並進行現場安裝，費用可低至$800至$2,000（材料及基本人工），適合需要在售房前快速升級的業主或投資者。

定制步入式衣櫃：$5,000 – $15,000+

在大溫哥華地區的住宅中定制一個步入式衣櫃——如列治文鎮屋或三角洲獨立屋的主人房步入式衣櫃——費用通常為$5,000至$15,000加元以上。一個8×10尺的標準步入式衣櫃，含雙層掛杆、層板、抽屜及LED照明，人工及材料費用約為$8,000至$12,000。

步入式衣櫃的主要費用驅動因素包括：

  • 軟關緩衝抽屜櫃：每個$400–$900
  • LED感應照明：$200–$600
  • 鏡面板或鏡門：$500–$1,500
  • 實木浮動層板：每組$300–$800
  • 衣櫃中島或半島台：$1,500–$4,000

溫哥華衣櫃裝修用什麼材料最好？

大溫哥華的氣候——夏季乾燥、冬季潮濕——會影響衣櫃材料的使用表現。顆粒板或MDF（帶封邊）是性價比最高的選擇，在室內溫控環境下表現良好。實木或膠合板貼面更耐用，長期來看更能抵抗輕微膨脹問題。

聚星裝修通常建議業主選擇膠合板基層配合層壓板或木皮飾面的構造，在耐用性和造價之間取得最佳平衡。實木僅在預算允許的豪華衣櫃項目中使用。

衣櫃裝修需要多長時間？

大溫哥華大多數衣櫃裝修工程從拆除到最終驗收可在兩週內完成。普通衣櫃改造工期為1至3天。含電工施工（新增插座或LED照明線路）的定制步入式衣櫃通常需要1至2週，包括所需許可證的申請時間。

BC省衣櫃裝修需要申請許可證嗎？

在卑詩省，單純的衣櫃裝修通常不需要申請建築許可證。然而，若工程涉及牆體改動、新增電路線路或修改房屋結構框架，則需要向所屬市政當局申請許可證。聚星裝修將許可證申請作為標準項目流程的一部分，協助業主處理所有手續。

如果您是將臥室改為衣櫃或在分契式住宅（strata）中添加衣櫃，請先諮詢您的strata委員會——部分裝修工程需要預先獲得strata批准方可動工。

聚星裝修衣櫃及定制儲物案例

聚星裝修已完成覆蓋大溫哥華各地的定制嵌入式儲物工程。以下是三個近期案例：

  • 三角洲整屋裝修——包含主人房衣櫃定制櫃體
  • 列治文整屋裝修——定制儲物櫃及衣櫃整理系統
  • 北溫哥華浴室裝修——套房浴室儲物升級

計劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修獲取免費報價。

衣櫃裝修費用：常見問題

2026年溫哥華衣櫃裝修的平均費用是多少？

大溫哥華地區衣櫃裝修的平均費用在$3,000至$8,000之間（定制普通衣櫃或小型步入式衣櫃）。含中島、實木飾面及照明的高端步入式衣櫃費用可達$15,000至$30,000。

售房前做衣櫃裝修值得嗎？

值得。專業衣櫃裝修通常能在轉售時收回70%至85%的成本（根據卑詩省低陸平原翻新回報報告）。設計合理的普通衣櫃是大溫哥華購房者最為青睞的裝修特色之一。

定制步入式衣櫃裝修需要多長時間？

大溫哥華定制步入式衣櫃裝修通常需要1至3週，具體取決於施工複雜度、是否含電工項目及材料供應情況。聚星裝修在估價階段提供詳細項目時間表。

溫哥華氣候適合用什麼衣櫃材料？

膠合板基層配層壓板或木皮飾面是溫哥華氣候的最佳全能選擇。避免在外牆或浴室相鄰的衣櫃中使用未密封的顆粒板。實木是高端選擇，適合溫控良好的主人房衣櫃。

BC省衣櫃裝修需要申請建築許可證嗎？

單純更換層板、掛杆和門板的衣櫃裝修通常不需要許可證。若工程涉及結構改動、牆體移動或新增電路，則需要向所屬市政當局申請許可證。聚星裝修代辦所有許可證申請。

計劃在大溫哥華定制衣櫃或進行全屋裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修獲取免費報價。
